objects.summary: Owner supplies the four requested WP2 historical objects. Owner verifies the seam on the exact base and exact hosted WP3 head, authorizing only the smallest synthetic deterministic binding using existing components. WP1 stays parked and WP3 promotion/deploy remain outside authority.

Codex refuses to implement against a non-authoritative shallow checkout, keeping WP2 as NARROW_JOIN_GAP_PROVEN_PENDING_EXACT_BASE_BINDING and requesting a portable exact-base tree/component bundle instead of inventing interfaces.

Owner starts the frozen WP2 mission on PR #39 created from exact Pass-B base, explicitly instructing no archaeology restart and no product-code change unless the proven seam requires the smallest lawful synthetic binding.

Codex reports a minimal WP2-only synthetic binding using native worker/fenced lease, existing DryRunExperimentRunner, existing verify_bindings evaluator and isolated sink; two qualification files only, 7 new tests plus 29 affected tests pass, and a self-qualified causality receipt is claimed pending independent review.

Owner/connector rejects the self-PASS because remote PR head remains documentation-only and commit 51b746... does not exist remotely. SELF_PASS != DURABLE_PASS; the implementation is not independently auditable. Required correction is transport-only, not reasoning restart.

Codex cannot recover the reported self-qualified bytes or commit from workspace/object DB and refuses to fabricate a patch bundle or approximate implementation. Working tree remains clean; durable causality claim is withdrawn.

Owner voids the lost implementation and orders WP2 rebuild V2 as a new candidate. Crucial evidence-procedure change: exact tested bytes must be emitted in a complete hash-addressed portable PATCH_BUNDLE before any PASS claim; explicit ceiling becomes SELF_PASS != DURABLE_PASS != INDEPENDENT_PASS.

cross_object_findings.finding: Historical MEGA-E, runtime/recovery and Live-Lab passes do not establish the Pass-B single-lineage task-to-lease-to-runner-to-evaluator-to-isolated-sink contract. Exact-base posterior evidence explicitly proves the narrow join gap.

The authorized closure path is intentionally tiny and synthetic-only: reuse existing worker, fencing/recovery, runner, evaluator and sink contracts; do not build another scheduler/control plane/Research OS.

A technically successful local repair became unusable when its commit/files were not remotely persisted. Independent review correctly rejected the claim despite passing tests, because workspace-only bytes are not durable evidence.

The qualified candidate had to be voided because its exact bytes disappeared. This is a concrete historical mechanism of lost person-days: ephemeral worker state caused a complete implementation rebuild even though the reasoning had already been done.
WP2 V2 changes evidence procedure so exact tested bytes/hash/bundle are durable before any PASS label. This directly addresses the project memory/restart failure without adding broad governance.
